timeline.text: Called Curexa before opening; after-hours line, voicemail cut off.
Business-hours retry to Curexa; reached main menu.
Curexa (Bianca Lin) replied: licensed in all 50 states; asked for discovery form.
Curexa discovery form submitted; Max replied open to a call.
Additional vendors vetted; Triad Rx and Beaker skipped, OpenLoop put on hold.
Outreach emailed to RedRock, CareValidate, Beluga and Precision.
Belmar call started to find telehealth partnerships contact.

vendors.name: OpenLoop
flags: Defendant in Day v. OpenLoop Health, RICO class action (D. Del. No. 1:25-cv-01418) over compounded oral tirzepatide. Allegations only, but reputational / LegitScript risk.
Related: Novo Nordisk v. Link Pharmacy (N.D. Tex. No. 3:25-cv-02061); Link reportedly shares holding companies with OpenLoop (unverified).

vendors.name: Triad Rx

Reportedly owned by OpenLoop's founders (allegation backed by state records).
